title: The Leray comparison on a supplied K-injective model
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of ringed spaces with chosen derived categories of module sheaves. Let $I$ be a K-injective integer complex on $X$, $K$ a derived object, and $r:K\simeq QI$ an isomorphism. Write $D=f_*$, $F$ for the abelian presheaf-section functor on $Y$, $P=F\circ D$, and $R_P$ for its recorded right-derived functor [lem-trf-unbounded-direct-image-section-presheaf]. Let $c$ be $R_P(r)$ followed by the fixed resolution isomorphism for the identity of $I$. Let $e$ be the published derived direct-image comparison $RD(r)$ followed by its fixed resolution isomorphism. Then $c^{-1}$ followed by the universal Leray comparison at $K$ and the derived-section image of topEdgeDirectImageComparison followed by $e$ equals the derived-section unit at $DI$ [def-weil-pbc-truncated-counit-edge]. This equation is before taking homology and involves no local-class map.

source.place: Tags 0D5W (lemma-Leray-unbounded), 0D5X (lemma-unbounded-describe-higher-direct-images), and 079V: fixed K-injective direct-image construction. The explicit unit-normalization calculation is agent-derived.

proof.text: Apply the fixed direct-image resolution normalization to r. Naturality of the universal Leray map moves r through that map; the inverse of R_P(r) cancels its forward map.

The identity-resolution comparison c on I is inverse to the derived unit of P. Precompose the universal Leray unit equation with this inverse; after the cancellation only the ordinary derived-section unit at DI remains. The quotient comparisons have identity components.

theorem resolutionLerayClassModel
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective]
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)))
    (r : K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) :
    let D := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f
    letI : D.Additive := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage_additive f
    let F := RingedSpace.localAbelianSections Y
    let P := D ⋙ F
    let R := P.rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutions
      (RingedSpace.localSectionsEnoughKInjectives X)
    let c := R.mapIso r ≪≫ P.rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutionsObjIso
      (RingedSpace.localSectionsEnoughKInjectives X) (𝟙 I)
    let e := D.rightDerivedFunctor.mapIso r ≪≫ D.rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso I
    c.inv ≫ (RingedSpace.localLerayComparison f).app K ≫
        (RingedSpace.derivedLocalAbelianSections Y).map
          ((RingedSpace.topEdgeDirectImageComparison f K).hom ≫ e.hom) =
      (F.rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutionsUnit
        (RingedSpace.localSectionsEnoughKInjectives Y)).app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
            ((D.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I))
